release_notes:
## Gradient description and optional integrations

- GEODE DESCRIPTION: Added a smooth cyan-to-mint-to-purple title gradient.
- NO REQUIRED BADGE MOD: Removed the unused Developer Badges dependency.
- OPTIONAL JUKEBOX: The Music card works with Geometry Dash's standard song widget and receives Jukebox enhancements automatically when Jukebox is installed.
- COMPATIBILITY: Pause Menu Studio now has no required third-party mods.
